title: 核冬十年
style_en: 10 years post-nuclear winter, ruined Taipei, underground metro settlement, cold desolate atmosphere, faint hope, muted palette

world.place: 廢墟化的台北，地下捷運站裡的倖存者聚落
world.extra: 淨水機壞了，聚落的存水只夠撐七天
world.goal: 找到淨水機的零件並平安帶回，讓聚落撐過這個冬天

protagonist.name: 阿岳
protagonist.profile: 聚落裡最年輕的探勘隊員，衝動但勇敢

characters.name: 陳姐
characters.appearance: 45 歲女性，灰黑色短髮，眼角有細紋，深褐色眼睛，軍綠色舊外套上縫滿補丁，腰間掛著手電筒
characters.relationship: 聚落首領，把主角當孩子看
characters.appearance_en: 45-year-old female, short gray-black hair, fine wrinkles at eyes, dark brown eyes, worn military green jacket with patches, flashlight on belt

characters.name: 小灰
characters.appearance: 13 歲少年，亂翹的灰色短髮，機靈的黑色眼睛，過大的灰色連帽衣，臉上戴著破舊防毒面具
characters.speech: 講話結結巴巴，緊張時更嚴重
characters.relationship: 拾荒少年，跟著主角出任務
characters.appearance_en: 13-year-old male, messy short gray hair, sharp black eyes, oversized gray hoodie, worn gas mask on face
